body:
Periodic gradient computation now defaults to two background workers in normal games, loaded saves, and structured headless runs. Explicit `--gradient-workers` overrides still apply, and publication keeps the existing eight-tick delay. Update the default assertion to omit the override and expect two, and update the documented default.

This is a requested configuration choice, with no new performance measurements or claimed speed/feel improvement. Worker count is local execution configuration, so simulation scheduling, save data, replay/network gates and SIM_REVISION remain unchanged.

Validation: all three edited C++ translation units passed syntax compilation; the current-source gradient pipeline harness passed 140,252 assertions; Python syntax and source-default checks passed. Full client linking/runtime-default checks and cross-platform runs were omitted for this literal configuration change. Local evidence is linked in the verification comment.
